checks: fixture backend changed-notification delivery appears through existing toast and bell without output paths or secrets
toast opens original v2 file result and reads trusted output without recapture or native write
bell detail follows unified original-operation routing; viewing marks read without fabricating resolve or repeat write
uncertain backend notification remains Unknown when viewed and cannot publish, verify or imply current synchronization
reloading the same persistent notification does not manufacture another toast
limits: Actual toast/bell/controller/central result UI and API wrappers with deterministic injected notification fixtures. Backend event persistence and worker feedback classification are L0 evidence, not proved by this browser test.
